run_dump_km_label_cli: run the CLI to dump k-means cluster labels for a feature shard given feat_dir, split, km_path, nshard, rank, and lab_dir
run_dump_label_function: run dump_label to apply a k-means model to feature shards and write cluster labels to a .km file
create_apply_kmeans_class: create an ApplyKmeans instance from a joblib k-means model path to assign cluster labels to feature vectors
test_apply_kmeans_call: test the ApplyKmeans callable by passing numpy arrays or torch tensors and verifying returned cluster assignments
review_get_feat_iterator: review get_feat_iterator to understand how it yields feature slices from sharded .npy files using offset and length metadata
